Whenever I’ve needed an appointment for my child, they’ve always done their best to see us quickly, which means so much as a parent. I was also recently sent for blood tests and received the results very quickly, with a follow-up arranged to discuss everything properly.

Yesterday I had my mole removed and I was feeling very nervous, but the doctor and nurse were incredibly kind and reassuring. They made me feel comfortable from start to finish, and the doctor was very gentle and professional throughout the procedure.

I also want to mention the reception team, who are always polite, friendly, and helpful — they really make a difference.

This is honestly the best experience I’ve ever had with a GP surgery.
